title: Five Hom bijections and evaluation for a tensor-preserving left adjoint
statement: Let A and B be categories with specified closed tensor-Hom structures S and T [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Let F:A→B be left adjoint to U:B→A and let μ:F(X tensor K)≅FX tensor FK be natural. Then U Hom_B(FK,N)≅Hom_A(K,UN) is natural in K,N. It represents exactly the five Hom bijections obtained from the two scalar transposes, the two closed transposes and μ. Its closed transpose is restricted evaluation after the scalar unit. This evaluation equation determines the comparison uniquely.

proof.text: Compose the five Hom equivalences. Naturality of the scalar and closed hom equivalences and μ proves precomposition naturality, and naturality in K,N. Write out uncurrying as tensoring the map with the identity followed by evaluation.

proof.text: Evaluate the bijection at the source identity to define alpha and its inverse bijection at the target identity to define beta. Precomposition naturality and inverse-equivalence identities show both composites are identities. The other naturality identity makes these component isomorphisms natural.

proof.text: Expand the value at the identity. Move the scalar unit in the second factor through μ and the outer scalar unit by naturality. The scalar counit cancels that unit by the triangle identity. This is precisely the restriction tensor map followed by restricted evaluation. Injectivity of the closed transpose gives uniqueness.
